hypothesis.proposedMutation: Add one loop-ext worker-capabilities module that owns episode capability composition and optional-tool dispatch (including instruction text, tool-set mutation, MCP admission, and delegation routing), then make loop.ts use that boundary while leaving generic conversation, tracing, budgets, and result accounting unchanged.
hypothesis.expectedBenefit: The core loop becomes capability-agnostic at its setup and dispatch points; adding or reviewing optional capabilities is localized, while existing phase gates, host admission, delegation limits, and tool semantics remain explicit in the adapter.
expectedRisks: A moved branch could accidentally alter ordering or error text for MCP/A2A/research calls.
The adapter may need broad dependency types, creating coupling in the extension module rather than eliminating it.
Tool capability composition must preserve the exact default tool set and phase restrictions.
